critical_code_review_comments: Registration accepts .local emails at the frontend (no client-side hint) but backend rejects them with 422 via email_validator's reserved-TLD rule. Consider (a) surfacing the specific reason to the user via auth-error, or (b) allow test/reserved TLDs since 422 is confusing when the user thinks their email 'looks fine'. In this run it caused a false test failure until the domain was switched to @example.com.

hero-cta-create is a <button> that uses navigate() rather than an <a href>; this works but breaks middle-click / open-in-new-tab UX and makes E2E link assertions harder. Consider using <Link> for consistency with hero-cta-demo.
